about: Whether what landed fits the node a listen states it is (`listen to hook-[:Requests]-><Payment> fire f`): a host checks each arrival that fires such a listen against the node, and one that does not fit runs nothing, the lines naming what does not fit. `source` names the program, `node` the type the listen states, `landing` the record's fields; `named` is the node's name as the lines name it, and `misfits` the lines, in the node's field order (its base's first), nested nodes after the fields, an empty list when it fits. A field the node marks `| null` may be absent; an enum takes only its values; `json` takes any value; a nested node is checked when present, each item of a list of them. Held by listen-fire's Rust (crates/movement-engine/src/listen_landing.rs) and the engine's TypeScript (landingMisfits, through the wasm).

cases.case: a landing that has every field fits, extra fields and all
each field that is missing or of another kind is named, its base's first, nested ones by their path
a nullable field may be null, and each item of a nested list is checked
a landing that is not an object is said whole
misfits: the body is a list, not an object

cases.case: a node named in backticks is named without them
